visual_brief.subject: Claude Code mods put TypeScript inside the agent event loop
verified_context: Anthropic introduced TypeScript mods for Claude Code on October 1, 2026.
Mods can intercept prompt, tool and permission events and run with the same machine access as Claude Code.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Review mod code, provenance and event order before installation; treat a mod as privileged local code.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A precision charcoal workbench has one terracotta interchangeable insert seated in its central mechanical passage. The insert changes how a pale slab passes through. This is a physical metaphor for customization, not a security diagram.
must_show: centered focal elements that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Viable canonical alternate. The seated insert is clear, but foliage, arches and distant scenery add secondary detail.
candidate_notes.B: Viable material alternate. The terracotta insert and pale passage are clear; the tight still life gives less negative space.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. The shallow cutaway isolates the insert changing the central pale passage. Charcoal and terracotta masses remain legible through every reviewed crop.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1200 x 430 center-cover crop inspected: the central metaphor remains readable.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 240 center-cover crop inspected: focal objects remain distinct.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 center-cover crop inspected: color and silhouette convey the same idea.
crop_review.home_square: 320 x 320 center-cover crop inspected: central focal elements survive; nonessential peripheral context is cropped.

golden_reference_comparison: Shares the plugin ecosystem and Copilot review-control references' warm stone, charcoal massing, terracotta mechanism and physical editorial metaphor. The tighter cutaway is denser and more photographic than their drawn architectural fields; Golden Reference Fit is 88. It would still look commissioned for the same publication without a headline.
